mapper.select: select * from refund_transaction where refund_no=#{refundNo} for update
select * from refund_transaction where order_id=#{orderId} order by id desc limit 1
select * from refund_transaction where status='FAILED' and next_retry_at<=#{now} order by next_retry_at,id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update refund_transaction set status=#{status}, attempt_count=#{attemptCount}, freeze_transfer_id=coalesce(#{freezeTransferId},freeze_transfer_id), release_transfer_id=coalesce(#{releaseTransferId},release_transfer_id), gateway_refund_no=coalesce(#{gatewayRefundNo},gateway_refund_no), failure_code=#{failureCode}, failure_message=#{failureMessage}, succeeded_at=#{succeededAt}, next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt}, version=version+1, update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{id} and status=#{expectedStatus}
